name: Binis
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Binis in Tirol

** **

Discover the unique charm of Tirol with its traditional Binis – the iconic wooden clogs that have been handcrafted for generations. Whether you're exploring the historic streets of Innsbruck, strolling through the picturesque villages of the Zillertal, or hiking in the breathtaking Ötztal, these sturdy and stylish shoes are a must-have for every visitor.

** **

Handmade with love in small family-run workshops, Binis are not just footwear—they’re a piece of Tirol’s cultural heritage. Lightweight yet durable, they’re perfect for both city walks and mountain adventures. Visit one of the many Bini-shops in Tirol to find your perfect pair and take home a piece of the region’s tradition.

** **

From the bustling markets of Hall in Tirol to the serene landscapes of the Lechtal, wear your Binis with pride and experience Tirol like a true local!

** **

Why Binis?

** **
  • Handcrafted with traditional techniques
  • Comfortable for all terrains – from cobblestone streets to alpine trails
  • A sustainable and timeless accessory
  • Available in a variety of styles and colors
** **

Where to Buy?

** **

Find authentic Binis in:

** **
  • Innsbruck – Bini-shops in the city center
  • Mayrhofen – The heart of the Zillertal
  • Sölden – A must-visit in the Ötztal
  • Landeck – Traditional craftsmanship in the Oberland
** **

Step into Tirol’s heritage—one Bini at a time!

**
